latest_release.name: Lichii nx2 build 150 (17baed7)
latest_release.body:
> **New here or getting bad performance?** Stop the game, then use **Help → Apply Recommended Settings...** to apply the recommended settings in one click. **Help → Restore My Previous Settings** undoes it.

Automatic build of `nx2` at 17baed716da04fd743fbd8f9604bec96eab0a123.

## What changed since build 130

Build 150 was built from nx2 17baed716d. Build 130 was 3dae119. That's 51 merged changes.

## Big fixes
- **Ocarina of Time: white wash / blown-out lighting fixed.** Destroyed GPU memory kept its old backing, so reused memory showed stale pages. Diagnosis and fix by 99ivs, with a safety refresh by PantACRO4life (#1236).
- **Mario Kart World: dark characters and karts fixed.** Compute shaders reading lighting data were cut off at 8 MiB and now see the whole buffer (#1231).
- **Ocarina of Time: out-of-memory crash on Windows.** The texture cache now stays within Windows' memory commit limit (#1210).
- **Ocarina of Time: ocarina crackle fixed** (ADPCM sign) (#1196).
- **Ocarina of Time: dark fairy fountain and Water Temple walls.** These are dumps with damaged texture members. Lichii now serves a stand-in instead of black (#1197).

## New features
- **NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 settings.** Pick the model preset (E/F/J/K/L/M or NVIDIA default; **M is the default**) and the quality (Automatic, Native DLAA, Quality, Balanced, Performance, Ultra Performance). The status bar shows `DLSS <mode> <preset>` while DLSS is active. Native DLAA path ported from myshadowww's #840 (#1249).
- **DLSS stays on** when NVIDIA warns about the VRAM budget, instead of switching itself off. By Christopher Peters (#941).
- **Ocarina of Time: AMD FSR 3.1 and FSR 4** in place of the game's anti-aliasing network. FSR 4 uses AMD's official runtime, downloaded on request. Includes camera jitter and LOD bias (#1060, #1061, #1062).
- **Lichii now has its own data folder** (`%APPDATA%\lichii`, `~/.local/share/lichii`), with a safe import from Eden. Copy keeps your old data, and an interrupted import can be retried (#1253, a port of gabriel-accetta's #1148).
- **Generated-frame FPS** is shown next to the FPS when frame generation is on. By Zarigis (#796).
- **No more recommended-settings pop-up on game boot**, so frontends launch cleanly. You can still apply the recommended settings from the Help menu (#1264, #1200).
- **UI translations ship in releases**, the status bar is translated, and zh_CN and es were updated. By janvitos, cirnoice9 and DevMikeRoger (#819, #826, #827, #893).

## Performance
- Fewer GPU commands per frame: dispatch barriers recorded with their dispatch, and in-order uploads batched. By jpkto (#1245, #1246).
- Faster texture swizzling on the CPU. By Marc Stampfli (#784).
- Skips texture uploads that a layer copy overwrites anyway (#1079).

## Crash and stability fixes
- Right-click in the game list no longer crashes on paths with non-ANSI characters (#1258).
- No crash when a buffer allocation goes over the memory budget. By Marin Salinas (#959).
- Changing settings while a game loads no longer freezes the UI. By Jay (#1168).
- Shutdown no longer hangs on threads waiting for the GPU. By jpkto (#1058).
- Lichii starts even when Windows blocks nxformat.dll, and nxformat is updated to 1.0.1 (#1127, #1078 by Bruno).
- The kernel shuts down cleanly when a file has no loader. By Eduardo Gomes (#972).
- Fixes a stale storage pointer when an evicted pipeline is rebuilt (#1143), and a GPU unmap on service command 102 (#1199).
- A clearer error when a pipeline fails because Windows ran out of commit memory. By janvitos (#807).

## Games and content
- DLC packaged inside a NUP is now found (#1257).
- The Duskbloods: colour grading fixed (3D texture slice copies). By cerroverb (#853).
- Audio no longer drops out on PipeWire and Steam Deck. By cerroverb (#850).
- IPSwitch patches: `\e` is read as ESC. By Amix (#1108).

## Platforms and packaging
- **macOS:** the app launches again on macOS 15.0–15.3 (#1254). macOS

detail.readme:
⚠️ Lichii has no official website ⚠️

> [!CAUTION] > **Lichii has no official website.** The only site run by this project is the **game compatibility website, [lichii.zortos.me](https://lichii.zortos.me)**, for compatibility reports only. Download Lichii **only** from this repository's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases). Any other "Lichii" website or download (such as lichii.org) is not ours and may contain malware ([#545](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/545)).

# Lichii Lichii is an experimental, open-source Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 emulator written in C++. It builds on Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi, preserving their contributions while developing this fork's game compatibility and renderer fixes. This is an independent fork, not an official release of those upstream projects. Lichii is not affiliated with Nintendo. Visit the [Lichii game compatibility website](https://lichii.zortos.me) to find games and compare community compatibility reports. ## Downloads and setup Download Lichii only from this repository's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases). Lichii has no other download site: archives offered elsewhere, such as lichii.org, are not built by this project, and one has been reported to install malware ([#545](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/545)). On Windows, extract the entire build archive and run **lichii.exe**. Only use games and system files you have legally obtained. Games, keys and firmware are not included. ### Existing saves and settings Lichii uses its own profile: `%APPDATA%\lichii` on Windows, and the `lichii` directories under `$XDG_DATA_HOME`, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and `$XDG_CACHE_HOME` on Linux and macOS. Without XDG overrides, these are `~/.local/share/lichii`, `~/.config/lichii` and `~/.cache/lichii`. An existing portable `user/` directory still takes priority and is not imported or changed by the wizard. On the first non-portable GUI launch, Lichii offers to import Eden and other detected emulator profiles. Back up `%APPDATA%\eden` first on Windows, or the old data, config and cache directories on Unix, and close the source emulator. Choose **Keep Old Data** to copy without changing the source, then check your saves and relaunch. Existing destination data is retained in backup directories rather than merged. Move also retains a source backup until you remove it yourself; Link deliberately shares settings and saves. Paths outside the imported data root remain shared and unchanged. An interrupted import offers recovery on the next launch. `eden-cli`, including `--help` and `--version`, refuses to initialize configuration until you import or explicitly choose **Start fresh** in the GUI. ## Compatibility and issue reports Compatibility and performance vary by game, hardware and driver. Rendering errors, stutters and crashes remain possible. Passing automated tests does not establish that a game renders correctly, and this project makes no universal frame-rate guarantee. Browse [community compatibility reports](https://lichii.zortos.me/reports) for results with each player's build and setup. Desktop reporting requires a build containing [PR #303](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/303) and is not available in build 88. In builds that include it, play and stop a Switch 2 game, then right-click that game and choose **Submit compatibility report**. Only the latest session in the current Lichii process is eligible. Confirm the matching website catalog entry and review the editable machine, game, setup, and enabled add-on details prefilled where available. Check the public preview and give explicit consent before submitting. Nothing uploads automatically, and the native v1 reporter does not read or upload logs or files. When [reporting an issue](https://github.com/zortos293/Eglantine/issues), include: - The exact build, game version, CPU, GPU and driver version. - Relevant settings and steps to reproduce the problem. - A screenshot and the log from the affected session, after checking it for personal information. Do not upload game files, keys, firmware or private account information. ## Building and contributing See the [build guide](docs/Build.md), [user documentation](docs/user/README.md) and [coding guidelines](docs/Coding.md). Some inherited documentation and internal build target names still use upstream names. The GUI build target remains `yuzu`; its output is `lichii.exe` on Windows and `lichii` on other desktop platforms. Keep changes focused and distinguish code-level checks from actual gameplay testing. ## Artwork Art created by YOB (yobslab) The supplied Lichii logo, icon and library artwork are in [dist/branding](dist/branding). Windows, Linux and macOS icon resources are generated from that artwork by [Generate-LichiiIcons.ps1](tools/Generate-LichiiIcons.ps1). ## Support Lichii Lichii is free and stays free. If you want to help, you can donate in crypto. Donations help pay for the AI tools and build machines used to develop this open-source project faster. **Solana (SOL)** ```text JepEjfyWjGjhJvHSrqj52KtLjcbbbmUh1iGqerYBF4w ``` **Ethereum (ETH)** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` **Bitcoin (BTC)** ```text bc1qcvxdpf4qvdhqp8ee4s355cjmxrzsphsdwpl8w4 ``` **BNB Smart Chain (BNB)** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` **Polygon** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` Send each coin on its matching network. Coins sent on the wrong network can't be recovered. > [!NOTE] > Donations are voluntary gifts and are non-refundable. A donation does not buy any product, service, perk, early access, exclusive build, priority support or say in the project. Every release stays free and public for everyone. ## Credits and license Lichii inherits the work of the Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi projects and their contributors, including Eglantine's original developer Camille LaVey. Original copyright notices and third-party licenses are retained. See [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt) and the source files for applicable license terms.
